title: Update GUI API and frontend
description:
Plan Context: Replace per-store auto-increment numeric `id` on knowledge insights with UUID v4 strings, eliminating cross-store ID collisions and enabling stable IDs across moves/copies.

Description: Update `parseKnowledgeId()` to validate UUID format, update `KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema.superseded_by` type, and update the frontend knowledge view to display UUID-based IDs.

Scope:
- `mcp-server/gui/api-knowledge.ts`
- `mcp-server/gui/public/views/knowledge.js`

Deliverables:
- `parseKnowledgeId()` validates UUID format via regex and returns a string (was: integer coercion returning number).
- `KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema.superseded_by` changed from `z.number().int().nullable().optional()` to `z.string().uuid().nullable().optional()`.
- Frontend `superseded_by` display changed from `'Superseded by KN-' + ins.superseded_by` to `'Superseded by ' + ins.superseded_by`.

Estimated Complexity: Low

Code Observations: `parseKnowledgeId()` is at L170 in `api-knowledge.ts`, called by 4 handler functions (L302, L355, L413, L469). All callers pass the result to `KnowledgeStoreManager` methods that will accept string IDs after WP-002. `knowledge.js` uses `ins.id` for HTML attributes and `ins.superseded_by` for display — both work transparently with string UUIDs.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema` accepts `superseded_by` as a valid UUID string or null.

summary: Reviewed 2 files (mcp-server/gui/api-knowledge.ts, mcp-server/gui/public/views/knowledge.js). 0 Critical, 0 High, 1 Medium (missing escapeHtml on superseded_by), 1 Info (parseInt breakage for UUID IDs). Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: A03 (XSS) — Medium: knowledge.js ~L127-129: `ins.superseded_by` is concatenated directly into HTML without escapeHtml(). Every other user-visible field (title, category, repository_name, source, origin_plan, tags) uses escapeHtml(). The GUI PATCH write path enforces `z.string().uuid()`, but data written via MCP tools (ledger_update_insight) or pre-migration storage is not constrained to UUID format. If a non-UUID value (e.g. containing `<script>`) is present in storage, it would be rendered as raw HTML. Remediation: replace `'Superseded by ' + ins.superseded_by` with `'Superseded by ' + escapeHtml(String(ins.superseded_by))` — consistent with all other fields in buildKnowledgeHtml().

Info — Functional regression (not a security issue): wireEvents() in knowledge.js uses `parseInt(rawId, 10)` to parse `data-id` attribute values (line ~358). Post-UUID-migration, data-id attributes contain UUID strings; parseInt returns NaN, causing editingId/confirmDeleteId/movingId comparisons to always be false. Edit, delete, promote, and move card actions will silently fail to enter their UI states. Not a security vulnerability, but should be fixed alongside the escapeHtml remediation — change `parseInt(rawId, 10)` to the raw string value since IDs are now UUIDs.

summary: Production TypeScript in gui/api-knowledge.ts is clean and correct — parseKnowledgeId UUID validation and KnowledgeUpdateBodySchema.superseded_by are properly implemented. All 5 ACs are met in the source. One Fix-Forward applied (escapeHtml on superseded_by display). One blocking functional regression found in knowledge.js: parseInt(rawId, 10) at L355-356 and parseInt(formId, 10) at L454 both return NaN for UUID strings, completely breaking all interactive card mutations (edit, delete, promote, move) in the GUI.

comments.note: [BLOCKING] `wireEvents()` in `gui/public/views/knowledge.js` uses `parseInt(rawId, 10)` at L355-356 and `parseInt(formId, 10)` at L454 to parse `data-id` attribute values and form ID suffixes. With UUID IDs, `parseInt('a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890', 10)` returns `NaN`. Every subsequent `===` comparison against a UUID string (`editingId === id`, `confirmDeleteId === id`, `movingId === id`, `ins.id === eid`) evaluates to false, causing all interactive state transitions to silently no-op. Fix required (Developer): (1) L355-356: change `var id = parseInt(rawId, 10)` to `var id = rawId`. (2) L454: change `var eid = parseInt(formId, 10)` to `var eid = formId`. No other changes are needed — all `===` comparisons, DOM element lookups (`kn-edit-title-` + id), and API call arguments work correctly with string IDs.

[Fix-Forward applied] `gui/public/views/knowledge.js` L128: wrapped `ins.superseded_by` in `escapeHtml(String(...))` — consistent with all other user-visible fields in `buildKnowledgeHtml()`. No behavioral change for valid UUID values; prevents XSS for any pre-migration or MCP-written values containing HTML characters.

[documentation-forward] `gui/public/views/knowledge.js` top-level comment block should note that `data-id` attributes carry UUID strings (not integers) and that the `wireEvents` function reads them as raw strings without parseInt. Helps future maintainers avoid re-introducing this class of bug.
